societes.title: Delivery companies
societes.help: Delivery companies (with or without an API) and their rates (what they charge you). Companies with an API are connected in “API Integration”. Your own couriers are in “Couriers”.

api.title: API Integration
api.help: Pick a company and paste the keys of your account there. Each connection creates a delivery company: parcels are created there in one click and statuses update by themselves. You can connect several accounts of the same company.
api.none: No account connected: pick a company above.

form.name: Name
form.keySaved: Key saved: leave empty to keep it.

custom.testPath: Path to test the connection (GET, optional)
custom.bodyHint: {{…}} are replaced with the order details. Without quotes around: number or true/false.
custom.trackingPath: Where the tracking number is in the answer
custom.statusPath: Where the status is in the answer
custom.statusesAfter: Link the company's statuses to yours with the “Statuses” button of the list, after saving.

fees.title: Rates · {{name}}
fees.help: What the company charges you per wilaya: home delivery, stop desk and return fee. Used to compute the net in the cash page.
fees.fillHint: Tip: type a price in a column header then Enter to fill the empty cells.

desks.title: Stop desks · {{name}}
desks.name: Desk
desks.codeHint: Desk id in the company's API

statuses.title: Statuses · {{name}}
statuses.help: What each status of the company means for you. “Automatic” follows the built-in mapping; pick a status to override it.
statuses.empty: No known status yet: send parcels then update.

preview.title: Send preview · {{name}}
preview.help: What would be sent to the company for an order (nothing is sent). Keys are masked.

livreurs.title: Couriers
livreurs.help: Your couriers: create their account in Users with the Courier role. They see their parcels in “My round”. “End of round” sorts their route sheet: farthest first, coming back here.
livreurs.none: No courier: create an account with the Courier role in Users.
livreurs.endHint: Sorts the parcels: farthest first, coming back here.

zr.title: {{name}} from Pilotix
zr.hookHelp: {{name}} tells Pilotix about every status change of a parcel: no more waiting for the automatic update (every 30 minutes).
zr.hookOnDone: {{name}} will tell Pilotix about every status change

does.send: Parcels created at {{name}} as soon as they go to dispatch
does.labels: {{name}}’s labels: all in a single PDF
does.bags: Pickup bags made and printed in Dépôt › Dispatchées
does.changes: Modification requests (price, home ↔ stop desk, address, phone) from each parcel
does.exchanges: SAV exchanges sent as {{name}} exchanges, with their return
does.journey: Journey, SMS, driver and the customer’s return risk on each parcel
does.pay: Payments: request, date, received into the cash box
